name: SmartZoom
author: Kamran Ali

sections.description:
SmartZoom lets your customers examine product details up close with a smooth magnifying effect on product images. Ideal for stores selling clothing, jewelry, electronics, art, or any item where visual clarity is key.

Features:
– Lightweight and easy to use
– Seamless integration with WooCommerce galleries
– Enable/disable via settings panel
– Adjustable zoom level
– Compatible with most modern themes
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smartzoom/ directory, or install it via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Navigate to Settings > SmartZoom to configure options.
sections.faq:
Does it work with all themes?

It works with most themes that use the standard WooCommerce product gallery layout.

Can I change the zoom level?

Yes, the zoom level is customizable from the settings page.
